sentences.en: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
sentences.zh: 你是否会成功取决于你的努力。

sentences.en: No doubt he did his best, but he didn't succeed.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问他尽力了，但他没有成功。

sentences.en: If at first you don't succeed, try, try, try again.
sentences.zh: 如果你第一次不成功，那就再试一次，再试一次，再试一次。
